# Coming to be and ceasing to be keep pace / 开始成立与不再成立同步

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`coming-and-ceasing-keep-pace` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](coming-and-ceasing-keep-pace.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> In a finite family, coming to be and ceasing to be keep pace; this needs no premise.
>
> 有限之中，开始成立与不再成立同步；这不需要前提。

## Laws / 规律

1. The following hold of every web, with no premise about it. A determination comes to be across a step where it fails before and holds after, and ceases to be where it holds before and fails after; a formation arising and ceasing, a dependence forming and dissolving, and a condition coming to stand and ceasing to stand are this one change, read of activity, dependence and standing.<br>以下对每个依存网成立，不加任何关于它的前提。一个规定跨一步开始成立（之前不成立、之后成立）或不再成立（之前成立、之后不成立）；形成的生起与止息、依存的形成与消解、条件开始与不再作为条件而在，是这同一种变化分别读于活动、依存与水平。 (`Becoming.ComesToBe`, `Becoming.CeasesToBe`, `Becoming.Web.Ceases`, `Becoming.Web.CeasesToStand`, `Becoming.Web.change_readings`)
2. A decidable determination that holds and ceases to be at no later step holds on; a formation supported at one step is supported at another where each dependence it has at the other it had at the first, at no greater need, on a condition standing no lower.<br>可判定的规定在某步成立、此后没有一步不再成立，就一直成立；一个形成在某步被支持，在另一步仍被支持，只要它在后者的每个依存在前者都有、所需不更大、条件的水平不更低。 (`Becoming.persists`, `Becoming.Web.Supported`, `Becoming.Web.supported_of`)
3. Over any stretch of steps, an amount at the end with everything it fell is the amount at the start with everything it rose, and so for the total of a finite family with the rises and falls of its members.<br>任一段步上，一个量在终点加上其间的全部下降，等于在起点加上其间的全部上升；有限家族的总量连同成员的升降也是如此。 (`Becoming.rise`, `Becoming.fall`, `Becoming.over_stretch`, `Becoming.family_over_stretch`)
4. No amount falls below zero, so over a stretch a finite family falls by at most its total at the start more than it rises, and members falling at arbitrarily late steps rise at arbitrarily late steps: in every unfolding, levels of finitely many conditions that keep falling keep rising.<br>量不低于零，所以有限家族在一段步上的下降至多比上升多出起点的总量，成员在任意晚的步下降就在任意晚的步上升：每个展开中，有限多个条件的水平持续下降就持续上升。 (`Becoming.fallen_within`, `Becoming.rising_recurs`, `Becoming.Web.falls_need_rises`)
5. For one amount this is Becoming.Renewal's law that an observable never rising from some step on does not fall at arbitrarily late steps.<br>对一个量，这就是 Becoming.Renewal 中“从某步起不上升的观测量不在任意晚的步下降”。 (`Becoming.falls_not_recurring_from_floor`, `Becoming.falls_not_recurring`)
6. With the amounts bounded, the family rises by at most its bound per member more than it falls, and rising at arbitrarily late steps needs falling at arbitrarily late steps.<br>量有界时，上升至多比下降多出每个成员的界，在任意晚的步上升就需要在任意晚的步下降。 (`Becoming.risen_within`, `Becoming.falling_recurs`)
7. A determination counts as zero or one, so both hold of it: over any stretch, the members of a finite family holding at the end with those that ceased to be are those holding at the start with those that came to be; comings and ceasings differ by at most the number of members; and each recurs exactly when the other does.<br>一个规定只计 0 或 1，两者都适用：任一段步上，有限家族在终点成立的成员连同其间不再成立的，恰是在起点成立的成员连同其间开始成立的；开始成立与不再成立的次数之差不超过成员数；一方复现恰当另一方复现。 (`Becoming.mark`, `Becoming.held_over_stretch`, `Becoming.keep_pace`, `Becoming.coming_recurs_iff`)
8. Read of activity, given decidable activity: the members of a finite family of formations active at the end with those that ceased are those active at the start with those that arose; they arise at arbitrarily late steps exactly when they cease at arbitrarily late steps; and with finitely many formations, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does.<br>读于活动（活动可判定）：有限家族的形成在终点活跃的连同其间止息的，恰是在起点活跃的连同其间生起的；它们在任意晚的步生起恰当在任意晚的步止息；形成有限多时，某个形成在任意晚的步生起恰当某个形成在任意晚的步止息：生起复现恰当止息复现。 (`Becoming.Web.activity_over_stretch`, `Becoming.Web.arising_recurs_iff`, `Becoming.Web.Unceasing`, `Becoming.Web.unceasing_iff`)
9. Read of standing, with no premise at all: conditions of a finite family come to stand at arbitrarily late steps exactly when they cease to stand at arbitrarily late steps.<br>读于水平，不需要任何前提：有限家族的条件在任意晚的步开始作为条件而在，恰当它们在任意晚的步不再作为条件而在。 (`Becoming.Web.ComesToStand`, `Becoming.Web.standing_recurs_iff`)
10. Finiteness does the work: ever new formations can arise with none ceasing while a level rises at every step and never falls (Accretion), and formations all active at the start can cease one after another while nothing arises (Attrition).<br>有限性起作用：不断有新的形成生起而没有一个止息，同时一个水平每步上升、从不下降（Accretion）；一开始都活跃的形成可以一个接一个止息而没有任何生起（Attrition）。 (`Becoming.Accretion.web`, `Becoming.Accretion.unceasing`, `Becoming.Accretion.never_ceases`, `Becoming.Accretion.rises`, `Becoming.Accretion.never_falls`, `Becoming.Attrition.web`, `Becoming.Attrition.ceasing`, `Becoming.Attrition.nothing_arises`)
11. The activity law holds of every world in a local form: where one list covers the active formations from some step on and activity is decided, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does; finitely many formations in all is not needed, and Web.unceasing_iff is its corollary.<br>活动的规律对每个世界有局部形式：一个列表从某步起覆盖活跃者、活动可判定时，生起复现恰当止息复现；不要形成有限多，Web.unceasing_iff 是它的推论。 (`Becoming.Web.unceasing_iff_covering`)

## Conditions / 条件

- Commitments of the representation, not premises about the unfolding: change is read across discrete steps; amounts are natural numbers; counting needs the counted determination to be decidable at each step (decidable activity is a hypothesis of the theorems that use it; whether a level is positive is always decidable, so standing_recurs_iff needs none).<br>表示的方法承诺，不是关于展开的前提：变化跨离散的步读出；量是自然数；计数时，被计的规定在每一步可判定（活动的可判定性是相关定理的假设；水平是否为正总可判定，所以 standing_recurs_iff 不需要它）。
- The family is finite, given as a list, possibly with repetition; Accretion and Attrition show that both directions fail for infinite families. That recurring rises need recurring falls also needs the amounts bounded; a determination counts zero or one, so it always is.<br>家族有限：以列表给出，可以重复；Accretion 与 Attrition 表明无限家族中两个方向都不成立。上升复现推出下降复现还需要量有界；规定只计 0 或 1，所以总有界。

## Does not show / 未表明

- Recurring means occurring at arbitrarily late steps and gives no frequency.<br>“复现”是在任意晚的步出现，不给出频率。
- Keeping pace is of counts and says neither which formations arise or cease nor why.<br>同步是数目的同步，不说明哪个形成生起或止息，也不说明为什么。
- Formal laws are not taken for the deductive necessity of the whole for reality.<br>不把形式规律当作对现实的演绎必然性。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** An infinite family: ever new formations arise with none ceasing, while a level rises at every step and never falls (Accretion).<br>无限家族：不断有新的形成生起而没有一个止息，同时一个水平每步上升、从不下降（Accretion）。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Change.lean)
- **Counterexample / 反例:** An infinite family: formations all active at the start cease one after another while nothing arises (Attrition).<br>无限家族：一开始都活跃的形成一个接一个止息，没有任何生起（Attrition）。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Change.lean)

**Standard boundaries / 通用边界:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. 不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. 不含伦理谓词，不评价生起或消失。 · Stated for discrete steps. 按离散步骤陈述。 · Uses decidability of the named determinations, a logical commitment written as a hypothesis. 使用所述判定的可判定性，这是写成假设的逻辑承诺。 · Names follow Ren's naming criteria of 10 October 2026 and are adopted where the statement has their exact meaning (Ren, 12 October 2026); readings not marked as Ren's are decided by the AI on Ren's delegation of 15 October 2026, which Ren can reverse. 名称依 Ren 2026年10月10日的命名标准，在陈述有其确切意义处采用（Ren，2026年10月12日）；未注明属于 Ren 的读法，依 Ren 2026年10月15日的交托由 AI 决定，Ren 可以改动。

### Correspondence / 对应

Ren's proposal: counting the whole space, generative and degenerative, the theory of becoming may need no axiom, and adding axioms defines a part of the whole space (2026-10-08-theory-of-becoming-priority). This result gives a set of laws holding of the whole space: they hold of every web, with no assumption about it, while the laws of the earlier modules (under Dependent, Balances, Dissipative, Embodied, Carries) name their premises. The one the author finds most contentful: in a finite family, coming to be and ceasing to be keep pace, arising is unceasing exactly when ceasing is, and coming to stand exactly when ceasing to stand. The author reads this as one formal content of Ren's scope, formation, persistence, transformation, degeneration and dissolution within one unfolding (an AI argument): in a finite family there is no unceasing arising without unceasing ceasing, and no unceasing ceasing without unceasing arising; arising without ceasing needs ever new formations (Accretion), and ceasing without arising needs endlessly many at the start (Attrition). This is a reading of activity, arising and ceasing being names Ren confirmed (2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names); it is not the proposal's generative and degenerative (Ren wrote ‘generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧’, a tag question presuming that they do not overlap, so this reading is not what is meant; they read as widening and narrowing what can form, DELEGATED-CHOICES D2): coming to be and ceasing to be keep pace here in a finite family; for the reading as relations see Web.renewing_not_consuming. The Chinese terms proposed for ceasing and coming to be are the AI's, adopted under Ren's naming rule (DELEGATED-CHOICES D36).<br>Ren 的提议：计入整个空间，包括生成与退化，生成之论或许不需要公理；加上公理，就划出整个空间中的一部分（2026-10-08-theory-of-becoming-priority）。本结果给出对整个空间成立的一组规律：它们对每个依存网成立，没有关于网的假设；以前各模块的规律（Dependent、Balances、Dissipative、Embodied、Carries 之下）都写明前提。其中作者认为最有内容的一条：在有限之中，开始成立与不再成立同步，生起不息恰当止息不息，开始作为条件而在不息恰当不再作为条件而在不息。作者把这读作 Ren 所说“生成、维持、转化、退化与消失在同一展开中”的一种形式内容（AI 论证）：在有限的家族中，没有不伴随止息的不息生起，也没有不伴随生起的不息止息；只有生起而无止息需要无尽的新（Accretion），只有止息而无生起需要无尽的初始（Attrition）。这是活动的读法，英文名称 arising/ceasing 经 Ren 确认（2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names；中文 生起／止息 是 AI 的译名）；它不是 Ren 提议中的“生成的”“退化的”（Ren 写道“generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧”，以“吧”预设二者不重叠，所以这一读法不是其所指；二者读作对能形成者的扩大与缩小，DELEGATED-CHOICES D2）：这里的开始成立与不再成立在有限之中同步；作为关系的读法见 Web.renewing_not_consuming。“止息”“开始成立”等中文用语是 AI 的提议，按 Ren 的命名规则采用（DELEGATED-CHOICES D36）。
